prior_blocker.root_cause: The candidate DSH was started without NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, so the Node runtime could not validate the DeepSeek TLS chain (UNABLE_TO_GET_ISSUER_CERT_LOCALLY) and every model call failed with TRANSPORT after five retries. The same start also lacked COMPETITION_HTTP_BASE/COMPETITION_HTTP_TOKEN, so competition_growth_patch was not registered in the tool list.

steps: Restarted the owned candidate with HOME, LANG, TZ, PATH, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/etc/ssl/cert.pem, COMPETITION_HTTP_BASE=http://127.0.0.1:18083 and COMPETITION_HTTP_TOKEN set, keeping the same runtime dir and rebuilt plugin artifact.
Opened an authenticated browser session and sent the boundary regression prompt.
The next native read was denied by the competition-growth method boundary.

boundary_case.native_tool_result: isError=true, message 'competition-growth method boundary: after a competition method call, use only registered competition methods; native filesystem, shell, and other tools are unavailable for this turn'

reason: A registered competition method returned, then a native read in the same turn was rejected by the guard; an ordinary native turn with no competition call executed a native glob normally. This confirms the boundary is per-agent/turn and does not disable ordinary native sessions.
